summary: Iteration 42 regression: verified taxi vs delivery commission split, slim vendor media endpoint, subscription catalogues, and BusinessSearch cover rendering. 10/10 pytest tests pass; frontend renders 30 business cards with cover fallback logic and lazy-loads /api/vendors/{id}/media.
action_items: Optional doc-vs-code clarification: the review_request states 'any paid subscription (pro/premium) = 5%' but code and DRIVER_SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS pin premium taxi to 0% (taxi_cut_pct=0, driver_keep_pct=100). Confirm intended behaviour; if premium should be 5%, change TAXI_PLAN_RATES['premium'] to 0.05 and the plan feature copy in server.py:160-165.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >10k lines; long-term should be split into routers. Not blocking.
_finalize_driver_split labels remain 'driver_delivery_portion' / 'platform_delivery_portion' even for taxi orders where the underlying value is the fare; consider renaming for clarity in reporting.
test_credentials: N/A - all tested endpoints are public / DB-seeded
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up per-test TEST_ prefixed docs in merchant_storefronts and orders collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite uses a shared asyncio loop (_LOOP module-level) so that server.py's motor client bound at import stays valid across all tests. Do not create a new loop per test. Verified: taxi splits 20/5/0 for std/pro/premium; delivery unchanged 20/10/0; GET /api/vendors/{id}/media returns slim payload {vendor_id,cover,logo} with no gallery field; both /driver/subscription/plans and /merchant/subscription/plans respond healthy. Frontend BusinessSearch (/businesses) renders 30 cards with data-testid=business-card-<i>; covers are lazy-loaded per card and only shown when merchant_storefronts has cover or logo; gradient+icon fallback confirmed for the rest.
